chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Two jobs on arriving in New York, September 1928
summary: He took jobs with Louis Russell and Willie Lynch after Russell's bass player left.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: No, the biggest band I met was Wes Helvey's band and that was the best one then. Then after I left them I went for about a year; to Buffalo, New York and played there/ and after I left there I went to New York. That was September 28, 1928. I got two jobs.
With Louis Russell. in one band, and Willie Lynch, on the other band. The bass player that was playing with Louis their Russell during intermission, he got up and (left) Louis Russell.
and there instead where the orchestra was. Russell sent for me to come ... He asked me would I play, and I did. I played the next night.
